_comment: velocity m/s, gravity = projectile gravity scale. Optional: acceleration (m/s^2, negative = slows down) + acceleration_time (s), arc low/high, aim overlay/elevation, unit deg/mil, angle_offset, min_distance, elevation_limits [min,max], bore (deg: how far above the screen centre the shot leaves; the game fires along the barrel socket Attach_Muzzle, tilted against the camera), zoom (FOV divisor of the RMB view; 1 = the sights, no zoom) + zoom_bore (bore in that view), category, note. Sources: velocity, gravity and rocket boost read from the game files (Squad build 26005357: WeaponConfig.MuzzleVelocity, projectile ProjectileGravityScale, ConstantAcceleration/Timeout capped at MaxSpeed); elevation limits, arcs and the AGS-17 hold model from in-game measurements, the official Squad wiki (squad.fandom.com) and SquadCalc (github.com/sh4rkman/SquadCalc).

MK19.note: Fire short bursts and walk the impacts onto the target; minimum arming range ~30 m. The tripod MK19 (and C16 / L134A1) fires faster: pick "MK19 · emplacement / C16 / L134A1"; for the AGS-17 pick "AGS-17 · emplacement". M1117 and AAVP-7A1: the gunner's sight at ×1, ×4.5 (the zoom key cycles the levels, pick yours with the view switch); the barrel and the camera are aligned (the shot leaves through the screen centre). For the other vehicles pick their own entry.

MK19 · PARS III RWS.note: PARS III remote turret: the gunner's sight at ×1, ×3, ×9 (the zoom key cycles the levels, pick yours with the view switch); the shot leaves 0.95° above the screen centre (zero ~180 m).

MK19 · TAPV C16 RWS.note: TAPV C16 remote turret: the gunner's sight at ×1, ×5, ×12 (the zoom key cycles the levels, pick yours with the view switch); the shot leaves 1.55° above the screen centre (zero ~295 m).

MK19 · M113 open turret.note: M113A3 / M113A2T open turret: the camera and the barrel are aligned without RMB; aiming with RMB moves the camera to the sights, which look 1.6° below the barrel (zero ~300 m, no zoom) - pick the view you aim from.

MK19 · M1151 / RHIB open turret.note: M1151 / RHIB open turret: the camera and the barrel are aligned without RMB; aiming with RMB moves the camera to the sights, which look 1.72° below the barrel (zero ~325 m, no zoom) - pick the view you aim from.

MK19 · emplacement / C16 / L134A1.note: Tripod MK19, C16 and L134A1: 235 m/s against 230 m/s on vehicles. Without RMB the shot leaves through the screen centre; aiming with RMB moves the camera to the sights, which look 1.674° below the barrel (zero ~330 m, no zoom) — pick the view you aim from. Fire short bursts; minimum arming range ~30 m.

AGS-17 · emplacement.note: AGS-17 with the PAG-17 optic (RMB, ×2.5). High arc: W puts the barrel up, hold S for the shown time. Low arc: aim with the overlay mark, which accounts for the optic's 0.85° socket (zero ~58 m). Velocity 185 m/s and gravity ×1.8 come from the game files; the hold rate and the top of the mount are fitted on 67 in-game hold-time measurements (280–1930 m, 7 m RMS error), the same as the Deadline SquadCalc. The fitted top, 85.87°, is the mount's 85° limit plus this optic's 0.85°, so the fit is of the optic gun; for the open-sight gun pick "AGS-17 · iron sights emplacement".

AGS-17 · iron sights emplacement.note: AGS-17 with open sights. Its barrel socket is tilted 4.5° up (the optic gun's is 0.85°), so the same mount angle shoots 3.65° higher: the top of the hold is 89.52° (the mount's 85° limit + 4.5°) and a target 33 m away can be lobbed. High arc: W puts the barrel up, hold S for the shown time. Low arc: aim with the overlay mark; the sights are zeroed at ~300 m. Velocity, gravity and the hold rate are those of "AGS-17 · emplacement"; the top is derived from the game files, not measured in game.

QLZ87.note: Tripod QLZ87. Its optic (RMB, ×3) is zeroed at 100 m; without it the shot leaves 0.9° below the screen centre — the mark accounts for both, pick the view you aim from. Fire short bursts; minimum arming range ~30 m.

QLZ87 · Lynx / CSK131.note: QLZ87 on the Lynx, CSK131, WZ551 and ZBL-08: the shot leaves 0.85° above the screen centre (zero ~110 m), with or without the optic (RMB, ×3). Fire short bursts; minimum arming range ~30 m.
